propositions: Signed gate verdicts record only a resolved provider:model string, so a consumer cannot distinguish a Bedrock-backed verdict from an Ollama- or Anthropic-backed one.

Add a sibling additive provider_provenance object holding provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities, leaving the legacy model string untouched so older readers ignore the new key.

The provenance record must be assembled in the leaf capabilities.py from primitives (provider, model, base_url, caps) reusing the once-computed capability record, never recomputing it or importing runner/providers.
endpoint_host must use urlparse(base_url).hostname to strip userinfo so no credentials from base_url or api_key ever reach the persisted payload, verified by a negative-control credential test.

The plan-review, completion, and code-review gate verdicts are assembled by separate paths (finalize_verdict, gate_ops) that never set provenance, so the field was absent in production despite passing unit tests until wired from the verify step's agent outputs.
Story sequencing requires supports_temperature (from story 2932) to land before signing so the capabilities sub-object shape is complete before any payload is signed.
